programs.showName: Once Upon a Time... In Hollywood
programs.description: Rick, a fading actor, and Cliff, his stunt double, struggle to find relevant work in Hollywood and go through various twists and turns in order to restart their careers.

programs.showName: A Beautiful Day in the Neighborhood
programs.description: Two-time Oscar winner Tom Hanks portrays Mr Rogers in a timely story of kindness triumphing over cynicism, based on the true story of the friendship between Fred Rogers and journalist.
